provenance.licence: World Bank dataset terms: CC BY 4.0 unless specifically labelled otherwise (this file is not labelled otherwise), with the World Bank's additional terms. The World Bank does not endorse this map or its use of the data.
provenance.changes: Reduced by b0b.dev to one point per flare id: its latest location and metadata, the 2025 volume, the peak year and the years with a detected volume. Volumes are million cubic metres per year.
provenance.caveats: Annual volumes estimated from satellite-detected heat (VIIRS Nightfire), not live detections. The publisher notes the field metadata may be out of date.
